en: A sepia-toned postcard showing a grand, neoclassical building with a portico of columns and mansard roof, with people in period clothing and horse-drawn carriages in front. Trees line the broad street, and benches are visible. The front side has the printed text 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Fürstl. Kurhôtel.' The reverse has standard postcard markings, a publisher's imprint, and a logo for 'Museum Im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.'
